parts.text: Regenerate the truth-reader implementation with this latest correction as authoritative and preserve all still-applicable prior requirements. IMPORTANT: preserve the existing ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/dependency-map.json contract, including its sentinel_file and mappings object; extend it for truth-readable document registry/provenance rather than replacing existing mappings. Canonical paths must be full repo-relative paths such as ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/Agents.md, ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json, ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/README.md, ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/MANIFEST.md, and ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/tests/step-3-evaluation.json. Per-document stable-reader provenance remains owned and updated deterministically by the dependency-sync mechanism only when that canonical source changes. Stable readers remain complete ordered JSON arrays derived mechanically from canonical content. For each challenge, create an ephemeral active seeded projection from the stable reader. THE ACTIVE PROJECTION ITSELF IS THE ONLY WORKER EVIDENCE SURFACE; do not use a separate submitted seed array or evidence.json. Truth seeds are separate items distributed across the projection. Each seed item must contain at minimum type='truth_seed', a unique seed id, seed_value=<fresh CSPRNG seed>, and proof_value=<a string consisting only of '0' characters exactly equal in length to seed_value>. The worker must prove reading by SWAPPING those two values in place for every seed item: after the worker commit, seed_value must equal the original all-zero proof_value, and proof_value must equal the exact original CSPRNG seed. The worker must not alter content items, metadata, provenance, challenge id, seed ids, item order, number of elements, or any other projection field. The workflow must retain a trusted exact original seeded snapshot for each active projection so verification can compare worker-edited projections against the original. Verification PASS requires, for every seed item, original seed_value moved intact into proof_value and original proof_value moved intact into seed_value, with all other fields byte/semantically unchanged. No seed ordering array is needed because each seed proves itself at its own position. On verification FAIL, do not advance or reset the challenge: replace every worker-edited active projection with its exact original seeded snapshot and commit that restoration using GITHUB_TOKEN so the same challenge can be retried. On PASS, perform one atomic cleanup/reset commit: selector booleans false, remove/clear active challenge snapshots/projections as designed, persist compact PASS status, and do not rewrite unchanged stable readers. Workflow-generated commits must not recursively retrigger. The worker verification workflow must trigger on commits to the active projection files themselves. Keep deterministic Node logic; Gemini must not decide truth, provenance, seed comparison, restoration, or reader construction. Return response_type truth_reader_implementation with files[] containing exact repository paths and COMPLETE contents for every changed/new file, especially dependency-map.json, gemini-supervisor-dependency-sync.yml preserving its existing alignment behavior, deterministic stable-reader sync helper, truth challenge engine, truth challenge workflow, selector/status/catalog surfaces, and any snapshot/state files required.
